text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When we stopped by a restaurant on the way 
back from our outing.

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting. Here is our 
Royal-Style Roasted Duck, finished with a 
molasses glaze.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We relished the delicious food. However, 
Orfevre...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
choice_data_list: ...? Orfe?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—...You there, staff. Bring me the chef 
who prepared this dish.

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
The chef, you say? Um, was there something 
wrong with your meal?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"I told you to call me by that. —Do not 
trouble me."

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: —Kh!! Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A chef stood before Orfevre. Overwhelmed 
by the heavy air she exuded, the chef 
seemed completely intimidated...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Are you the one who cooked this dish?

text_block_list.name: Chef
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes, that is correct...!! U-Um, did I 
do something wrong...?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
This roast duck... With every bite, the 
duck's distinct savory flavor and fat 
spread across the palate before melting 
away. Exquisite heat control.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The crowning touch is the molasses glaze. 
Its subtle sweetness gives the meat a 
rich, deep flavor you're sure to enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I praise your skill for delighting my 
palate. Continue to pursue dishes of 
supreme perfection.

text_block_list.name: Chef
text_block_list.text:
~~...gh! I-I am truly honored and humbled! 
I shall devote myself entirely, aiming for 
even greater culinary heights, and strive 
with all my might...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With tears of joy in his eyes, the chef 
took off his hat and knelt down. Moved by 
the moment, the other staff members bowed 
their heads respectfully as well.
choice_data_list: (W-Wow, what an incredible sight...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, on the way back to the academy 
after finishing our meal...
choice_data_list: …Huh? My wallet's gone…!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I had it when I paid. Then it must be at 
the shop.
choice_data_list:
You might be right! I'll go grab it real 
quick!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, I found the wallet right 
away. When I hurried back to where I 
parted ways with Orfevre, a crowd had 
formed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Chatter chatter chatter...!)
choice_data_list: What's with this crowd of people...?
What's with this huge crowd...?

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"To think I would meet you in a place like 
this is the absolute height of good 
fortune...! May I burn the sight of your 
figure into my memory...?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Very well. You have permission.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fan
text_block_list.text:
H-Hahahaaa! Your generous consideration 
brings me the utmost happiness...!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Her golden hair shines so brilliantly...! 
What a truly divine presence she 
possesses...!

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I dare not even raise my head! Just 
being in the same room as you is far too 
great an honor...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The gathered crowd is completely 
captivated by Orfevre's charm. I am once 
again in awe of her charisma.
choice_data_list: (Orfe really is amazing...!)
(Orfe really is incredible...!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —...Finally back, are you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"What are you doing over there? Come to my 
side at once."

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text:
—Huh? That person is being summoned? —That 
ordinary person...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's eyes turned toward me all at 
once. Feeling entirely out of place, I 
couldn't help but tense up, but...
choice_data_list: (Still, I'm being called, so I should go.)

(Is it really okay for me to stand by her 
side...?)

(Is it really okay for me to stand by her 
side...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's eyes turned toward me all at 
once. Feeling entirely out of place, I 
couldn't help but tense up, but...
choice_data_list: (Still, I'm being called, so I should go.)

(Is it really okay for me to stand by her 
side...?)

(Is it really okay for me to stand by her 
side...?)

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text:
—Grrr, I'm so jealous I can't stand it! 
—To think she gets to stand by that 
person's side...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bracing myself, I approached her. All the 
while, hearing the envious murmurs around 
us truly drove the reality home.
choice_data_list:
(The Uma Musume I'm in charge of really is 
special.)

(The Umamusume I train is someone truly 
special.)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...That timid, fearful attitude of yours. 
It's truly irritating.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Show me with your very body. The honor of 
serving me."
choice_data_list: …! Y-Yeah…!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I am Orfevre's Trainer." —Holding that 
pride tightly in their chest, they stood 
by her side.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: What are you hesitating for?
choice_data_list:
You're just so dazzling, I couldn't help 
it...

You were just shining so brightly, I 
couldn't help but...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: What a strange thing to say.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You exist to remain by my side, do you 
not?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "Don't waste my time. —Come."
choice_data_list: —...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I need to carry myself with more 
confidence as her Trainer... Vowing that 
in my heart, I walked over to her.
